unresolved_uncertainties: No production HTTPS deployment of the optional API has been observed.
No independent customer account or GitHub notification delivery has been observed.
Live installed replacement and fresh-host activation were observed only on one Windows host for earlier versions.
The analytics owner API has not been observed as a production HTTPS deployment and no public population count is established.
The agent-maintainer workflow has not run on GitHub with configured secrets against an eligible disclosed report.
The reusable managed-repair workflow and both protected environments have not yet completed a hosted producer canary.
Claude Code package verification does not establish live Claude discovery, invocation, or replacement until the other-PC checklist is observed.
The optional Codex plugin has not yet produced an observed trusted host continuation; the explicit consumer remains the proven path.
Producer identity is declared, not host-attested.
The v0.8.1 candidate is not a published or installed release until commit-bound CI, GitHub release, managed replacement, and fresh-host activation gates pass.
Producer-repository issue routing does not prove that every destination repository has the protected agent-maintainer workflow or required secrets installed.
